source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Data Recovery Methods' (PDF 21): the same text in simple Roman Urdu with glossed hard words, a self-check and a recap.

blocks.text: Data recovery lost (zaya shuda) data ko restore karne (wapas lane) ke liye istemal hoti hai. Recovery ke liye backup files istemal hoti hain. Recovery software deleted (mitaayi hui) files wapas lane mein madad deta hai. System restore system ka data recover kar (wapas la) sakta hai. Professionals (mahir log) damaged (kharab) devices se bhi data recover kar sakte hain. Recovery methods data loss kam karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Data recovery ke chaar tareeqe batayein.
blocks.explanation: Backup files se restore, recovery software, system restore, aur professionals se kharab device ka data nikalwana.

items: Recovery: backup files, recovery software (deleted files), system restore, professionals (kharab devices).
